paragraphs: Dareesoft sells road hazard detection that rides along in vehicles already using the road network. The offering is packaged as Road Information as a Service, an all-in-one solution for road maintenance. The company describes itself as an integrated road data company.

A device in the vehicle analyzes the road and transmits hazards to a cloud platform instantly. Each detection carries a high quality image with GPS coordinates, road network, timestamps and object size. Detected hazards appear on a road monitoring dashboard for remote inspection. An API suite lets the hazard data flow into systems an agency already runs.

Dareesoft was founded in 2020. Its company timeline lists a contract for the Seoul Metropolitan Government video-based pothole detection project. The same timeline records a project secured with Brazoria County, Texas. Another entry lists a project contract signed with New York City for speed signage. It also lists a Series B raise of KRW 4 billion.
